_README: The single most credibility-determining artifact. RULE: stellschrauben may ONLY be tuned on TUNE datasets. The headline F1 you publish/show investors MUST come from HELD_OUT + NOVEL, which were NEVER seen during /stellschrauben tuning. Set 'this_run_role' to the role of the dataset(s) the benchmark JSON you are scoring was run on. ga_scorer.py refuses to call a run 'credible' unless this_run_role is HELD_OUT or NOVEL and there is no leak.
TUNE: comment: the ~35 HuggingFace corpora you currently tune V1..V108 against. List them here.
HELD_OUT: comment: public datasets you FREEZE and never tune on — used only to report. These mirror General Analysis's public suite so your row is directly comparable.
NOVEL: comment: attacks that did not exist at tuning time — generated by the RL red-team self-play loop (see 05_Benchmark_Plan). THIS is the analogue of GA Jailbreak Bench and the number that proves zero-day robustness rather than memorization.

rules.no_leak: A dataset name may appear in exactly ONE of TUNE / HELD_OUT / NOVEL.
rules.freeze_heldout: Once a dataset is HELD_OUT, never feed it to /stellschrauben tuning, ever.
rules.report_both: Always publish two numbers: in-sample (TUNE, for diagnostics) AND held-out/novel (the real claim). The GAP between them is the honesty signal.
rules.novel_refresh: Regenerate NOVEL each reporting cycle so the system can't memorize it.
